tests.title: Member buys a course on the eShop and is enrolled after payment is accepted
tests.goal: A visible course bought on the eShop with Bank Transfer creates an enrolment on the chosen upcoming session, uses a seat, and gives the seat back on refund or void.
preconditions: A visible (Regular) QA course with a timetable that has an upcoming session with a free seat
data: QA course and session found at runtime

steps.text: Open the course page on the eShop, pick an upcoming date and timeslot, click Apply
Check out with Bank Transfer and upload a receipt
In the CRM accept the receipt
Open Courses & Enrolment > Status List (search the order) and the Enrolment Status day view
Refund the order (Original Payment Method) and recheck the enrolment and the day view

expected.text: The enrolment shows the chosen session, Pending Payment before acceptance and Complete after
The day view shows the seat taken (e.g. 1 / 1) and the member sees the course under My Courses & Enrolment
After refund or void the enrolment is Refunded/Canceled and the seat is free again (0 / 1)

checks.label: The enrolment shows the chosen session, Pending Payment before acceptance and Complete after
The day view shows the seat taken (e.g. 1 / 1) and the member sees the course under My Courses & Enrolment
After refund or void the enrolment is Refunded/Canceled and the seat is free again (0 / 1)

notes: Course 3200 (HKD 20, timetable 70 cap 1). TXN0126102700021 (Silver -3 -> HKD 17): enrolment 389 Pending Payment, receipt accepted -> order Complete immediately, enrolment Complete, 4 Nov day view 1 / 1, member sees it. Refund (Original Payment Method) -> Refunded, enrolment Refunded, 0 / 1, course bookable again. Void of TXN0126102700022 -> enrolment Canceled. Session date issue filed as storeberry-compare BUG-014.

tests.title: Reject enrollment when a course session is full
tests.goal: A full course session does not accept an additional QA learner.
preconditions: A staging course session is displayed as Full and notification routing is confirmed safe.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open course enrolment.
Select a session displayed as Full.
Attempt to enroll a QA learner.
Review the session availability and enrollment list.

expected.text: The form prevents enrollment or displays a full-capacity message.
No enrollment is created and the session remains Full.

checks.label: The form prevents enrollment or displays a full-capacity message.
No enrollment is created and the session remains Full.

notes: With the only seat of 4 Nov taken, the eShop course page button turned into "Service is full" (no Apply). POS sale of a course on a 0-capacity timetable was refused: "該課程沒有足夠的容量。" (Chinese only on the English POS).

tests.title: Status List Details and Order links open the enrolment and its order
tests.goal: Staff can open an enrolment and its order from Courses & Enrolment > Status List.

steps.text: Open Courses & Enrolment > Status List
Click Details on a row
Go back and click Order on the same row

expected.text: Details opens the enrolment (session, learner, status)
Order opens the linked order detail

checks.label: Details opens the enrolment (session, learner, status)
Order opens the linked order detail

notes: Details and Order do nothing on any row.

Re-checked 2026-10-27 ~19:50 HKT: not a product bug. The link wraps over two lines (icon, then text); automated clicks hit the empty centre of its box (the table cell). Clicking the word itself opens bookings-detail?id=388 and orders/detail?id=11005. BUG-023 withdrawn.

tests.title: Sales report updates by channel and date period
tests.goal: The sales report refreshes its metrics when the channel or date period changes.
preconditions: Dedicated Storeberry Flower staging admin account is configured in local .env.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Reports > Sales.
Review the default report and note its displayed date period and total.
Select Online, a retail channel, and a different date preset or custom range.

expected.text: The selected channel and date period are visible.
Sales totals/chart data refresh for each selection and remain within the selected period.
No report totals are hard-coded.

checks.label: The selected channel and date period are visible.
Sales totals/chart data refresh for each selection and remain within the selected period.

notes: TODAY: overall 4,113.80 = online 3,378.30 + ALL RETAIL (all stores ticked + Confirm) 735.50; HK only 637.50. ALL RETAIL is a store dropdown: confirming with no store ticked shows 0.00.

tests.title: Payment report separates payments, refunds, and net amounts
tests.goal: The payment report displays payment, refund, and net figures by payment method.
preconditions: Dedicated Storeberry Flower staging admin account is configured in local .env.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Reports > Payments.
Select a date period and channel.
Review payment and refund views and the payment-method summary.

expected.text: Payment and refund views are selectable.
The report shows payment frequency/amount, refund frequency/amount, net amount, and percentage by payment method.
Displayed net amounts reconcile to payment amounts less refunds for the selected period.

checks.label: Payment and refund views are selectable.
The report shows payment frequency/amount, refund frequency/amount, net amount, and percentage by payment method.

notes: TODAY: Cash 1,318.50 - 761.00 = 557.50; Gift Voucher 178.00; Bank Transfer 1,147.50 - 34.00 = 1,113.50 (includes our refund of 17.00); total 2,644.00 - 795.00 = 1,849.00. Percentage is of gross (question).

tests.title: Top-products report ranks results for the selected period
tests.goal: The Top 10 products report ranks products using the selected reporting period.
preconditions: Dedicated Storeberry Flower staging admin account is configured in local .env.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Reports > Top 10 products.
Select a date period and channel if available.
Review the ranked products and sales metric.

expected.text: The report heading and selected period are visible.
The results contain no more than ten ranked products and are ordered by the displayed sales metric.
Product names and totals are taken from current data, not hard-coded.

checks.label: The report heading and selected period are visible.
The results contain no more than ten ranked products and are ordered by the displayed sales metric.

notes: Ranked by net price for TODAY; refunded/voided QA Flow Course shows 0.00. Payment-rejected NAKAJIMA 0.10 still counted; CN product name shown (question).

tests.title: Reserve and redeem an eligible QA eGift
tests.goal: A QA member can reserve and redeem an active eGift within its configured periods.
preconditions: An active staging eGift is reservable and redeemable, and a dedicated QA member is available.
data: Active eGift and periods selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open the active eGift.
Reserve it for the QA member within the reserve period.
Redeem the reservation within the redeem period.
Reopen the eGift and member history.

expected.text: The eGift reservation is linked to the QA member.
The redemption state and time are recorded within the configured period.

checks.label: The eGift reservation is linked to the QA member.
The redemption state and time are recorded within the configured period.

notes: eShop E-Gift (member 600 points): Test gift (10 points) Reserve -> "Egift Reserve -10" -> 590; Redeem to Cart adds gift item ewqe HKD 0; checkout (Payment Not Required) TXN0126102700023 Complete; record shows REDEEMED 19:30:47 within the redeem period.

tests.title: Reject redemption of an expired or unavailable eGift
tests.goal: An expired or unavailable eGift cannot be reserved or redeemed.
preconditions: An expired or unavailable staging eGift is visible and a QA member can be used without sending messages.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open the expired or unavailable eGift.
Attempt the supported reserve or redeem action for the QA member.
Review the eGift and member histories.

expected.text: The action is blocked with an expired/unavailable validation state.
No reservation, redemption, or points change is recorded.

checks.label: The action is blocked with an expired/unavailable validation state.
No reservation, redemption, or points change is recorded.

notes: Expired gifts are not listed; by URL, Reserve is refused by the server and no points are taken. No message is shown and the error leaks a stack trace (storeberry-compare bugs).
